text: dsh-composer-ease 为 DSH Web 输入框加入编辑辅助与补全提示。它通过 Web 插件 bundle 挂接服务端候选路由和浏览器端输入交互。用户输入括号或引号时可自动补齐，选中文本后可用符号环绕，也能跳过已有闭符并一次删除空对。输入至少两个字符或按 Ctrl+Space 可查看来自草稿、语言词表、工作区文件、模型名和代码片段的候选；中文输入法的全角括号可转换为半角。适合希望在 DSH 网页输入代码或中文内容时减少重复操作的用户；不需要 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-composer-ease adds bracket pairing and completion to DSH Web. It wraps selected text, skips closers, and deletes empty pairs. After two characters or Ctrl+Space, it suggests draft words, language terms, workspace files, model names, and snippets. No API key or external service is required.
在 DSH 网页输入代码时，能不能自动补全关键字、文件路径和代码片段？
我想让输入的括号和引号自动成对，选中文字时还能直接用符号包起来。
Can I get code and workspace suggestions while typing in the DSH web composer?
dsh-composer-ease 的功能「输入符号配对与环绕」：在 DSH 输入框键入括号或引号时补上配对符号；选中文本后键入开符号可环绕选区，已有闭符可跳过，空对内退格会一并删除两侧。
dsh-composer-ease 的功能「上下文补全弹层」：输入至少两个字符或按 Ctrl+Space 请求候选，弹层可呈现草稿词、语言词表、工作区文件、模型名称及代码片段；用户可用 Tab 接受并用方向键选择。

dsh-composer-ease README · Summary：`dsh-composer-ease` is a DSH bundle plugin that adds a completion popup to the DSH Web composer, with bracket and quote pairing: brackets and quotes pair up, typing an opener over a selection wraps it, a closer over an existing closer is skipped, backspace removes an empty pair, and a completion popup opens after two characters. The browser half is plain DOM; the server half exposes two read-only loopback routes and writes nothing.

dsh-composer-ease README · Table of Contents：- [Install](#install)

dsh-composer-ease README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/mengge237/dsh-composer-ease
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-composer-ease
```

Desktop (Electron) uses its own plugin manager; `dsh plugin --profile desktop` is rejected by the CLI. When developing, the browser half is read from disk on every request (refresh applies), while the server half needs a `dsh web` restart.

dsh-composer-ease README · Use this package：| Action | Key / trigger | Behaviour |
|---|---|---|
| Auto pair | `(` `[` `{` `"` `'` backtick, full-width family | caret between the pair; no pairing after a path/identifier character, or when text follows the caret |
| Wrap selection | type any opener over a selection | `text` becomes `(text)`; single-line selections only (see boundaries) |
| Type-over / delete empty pair | closer already to the right / backspace inside `()` | no duplicate; both sides removed |
| Complete | two characters, or `Ctrl+Space` | popup: draft words, language tables, workspace files, model ids, snippets |
| Accept / navigate | `Tab` or click / `↑` `↓` | Enter stays the send key; `←` `→` `Home` `End` dismiss the popup and only move the caret |
| Dismiss | `Esc` | `Shift+Enter` still inserts a newline |

dsh-composer-ease README · Use this package：Completion follows the context: a fenced block selects the language table, otherwise the draft and the visible conversation vote, then the language you have been accepting candidates from.

dsh-composer-ease README · Understand the implementation：- `lib/index.js` — server half: `/dsh-composer-ease/words` and `/config.json`, both behind a loopback trust fence; ranking uses `lib/fuzzy.js` (VS Code's `fuzzyScore`, copied verbatim).
- `lib/client/*.js` — browser half, nine fragments concatenated into `lib/client.js` by `tools/build-client.mjs` (the host loads exactly one file).
- Chinese candidates come from the dictionary (`lib/cjk-lexicon.js`) only: the prefix is matched against the word list, so word length follows the data instead of a fixed cap.
- The popup is plain DOM anchored to the caret; it never touches the host editor's data model.

dsh-composer-ease README · Boundaries and known limits：See [docs/boundaries-and-implementation.md](docs/boundaries-and-implementation.md) for the measured list (multiline wrapping, insertion limits, IME behaviour, squiggle geometry) and the reason behind each.

dsh-composer-ease README · Development and tests：```bash
npm run build          # fragments → lib/client.js
npm test               # five offline suites, 185 items, zero network
npm run check:all      # structure, duplicates, refactor budget, docs, privacy, prose, copies
node test/real/matrix.mjs "http://127.0.0.1:3081/?token=…" 3 --verbose   # live matrix, 49 cases per round

dsh-composer-ease README · Development and tests：The host composer is Lexical: it ignores `sel.modify(...)`, ignores `beforeinput`'s `preventDefault`, and does not guarantee an `input` event — selection work uses flattened offsets plus explicit Ranges and cross-frame verification.

dsh-composer-ease README · Sources and licenses：- Interaction design follows Visual Studio Code (MIT); no source copied except `lib/fuzzy.js` (verbatim, see [THIRD-PARTY.md](THIRD-PARTY.md)).
- Word-table data comes from monaco-editor, codemirror/lang-html, codemirror/lang-css, MDN browser-compat-data and jieba's dictionary; each entry in THIRD-PARTY.md records repo, commit, files and the full license text.
- This plugin: MIT (see [LICENSE](LICENSE)).

dsh-composer-ease README · Dev note：- Change `lib/client/*.js`, then `npm run build`; never edit `lib/client.js`.
- Every convention has a runnable check under `tools/check-*.mjs`; CI only runs them (`.github/workflows/checks.yml`, ubuntu + windows, one run per branch via `concurrency`).
- Release: bump `package.json`, add a CHANGELOG entry with the commit sha, then `npm run check:all`.
